name: 複数の役割を示すメンバー属性
prompt: Faithfully recreate only the Japanese role-and-attribute card shown in the primary native preview. Use the exact 390x184 white canvas and preserve its compact layout, all Japanese labels, native colors and spacing. The pale mint rounded card begins near x=16,y=8 and is about 358x160px. Place the small muted title 「役割」 at x≈29,y≈22. Below it, lay out nine white rounded pill labels in a precise three-column, three-row grid. Each pill has a small forest-green dot on the left and dark muted Japanese text: row 1 「画面づくり」, 「企画担当」, 「学生」; row 2 「地域の仲間」, 「海外の仲間」, 「呼称：彼女」; row 3 「交流会」, 「確認済み」, 「個別連絡可」. Keep pill widths, x positions, row gaps and font size consistent with the native preview. All dots use the same green as the native Japanese preview, and all pills remain white. These are attribute labels, not hyperlinks; do not make any text blue. The original Discord screenshot is semantic context only. Do not copy its English labels, varied dot colors, source pill colors, action buttons, logos, photographs, statuses beyond the exact Japanese labels, extra text, shadows or borders. Render only this component.
reviewNotes: All nine Japanese labels and uniform green dots are correct. Side-by-side with the native preview shows card top, title and grid around 4–8px too low at native scale; card is slightly short at its top, while bottom aligns, and pills are about 3–4px too wide.
